ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  A.  Planning Commission Reorganization
  Recommended Action: Conduct the election ofChair and Vice Chair.

  Chair Leonard opened nominations for Planning Commission Chair.

  Page 2 of 13

  Commissioner Mazza nominated Commissioner Kamins for Chair.  Chair
  Leonard nominated Vice Chair Riddick for Chair.

  The question was called and Vice Chair Riddick was elected as Chair 4—1.
  Commissioner Mazza dissenting.

  Nixon Riddick administered the Oath of Office to Chair Riddick.

  Chair Riddick accepted nominations for Vice Chair

  Commissioner Mazza nominated Commissioner Kamins for Vice Chair and Chair
  Riddick nominated Commissioner Mazza for Vice Chair.

  The question was called and Commissioner Mazza was unanimously elected as
  Vice Chair.

ITEM 2.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Jo Drummond provided an update on rebuild progress. She asked the City
  Council to fast track all rebuilds from Building Safety into Plan Check and asked
  that the Planning Commission advocate for that as well. ln parallel. a group of
  residents have formed the Malibu Fire Resilience Council, beginning with a pilot
  in Big Rock. The goal is to develop a modern. science—based framework for life in
  the Wildland Urban Interface, to include fire—hardened homes. Independent and
  redundant water systems, defensible space and a return to ecologically grounded
  native species—based land management. The group hopes to find balance and
  create a unified vision that supports both.

  Anne Komarovsk congratulated the newly elected Chair and Vice Chair and
  reminded the public ofher candidacy for California State Governor.

  Dennis Smith complimented Chair Riddick on her service to the Planning
  Commission and appointment to Chair.

  Ryan Embree expressed concern regarding deliberations on an item on the
  November 3. 2025 Regular Planning Commission meeting. He stated that if
  Commissioners were unable to make the findings for an item. the Commissioners
  should either deny the project or abstain from the vote. He encouraged a narrower
  scope of public comment during public hearings. to be limited to information
  available to the public.
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes ofNovember 17. 2025
  Page 3 of 13

  Commissioner Leonard shared information provided by Councilmember Stewart.
  The Mountains Recreation and Conservation Authority (MRCA) sent letters to
  property owners adjacent to MRCA managed parklands which granted permission
  to access MRCA managed parklands for brush clearance to allow for two hundred
  feet of defensible space from homeowners‘ structures.

  Vice Chair Mazza clarified that homeowners adjacent to State Parklands not
  managed by MRCA would need to request permission for any brush clearance
  activities from the State agency that managed the relevant parklands.

  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR REPORT

  Associate Planner Azzaz provided a progress update on rebuild efforts. Assistant
  Community Development Director Eaton noted the cancellation ofthe November
  18m fire rebuild community session due to an anticipated rain event and upcoming
  meetings for design professionals and zone captain meetings. He noted that
  projects agendized for Planning Commission meetings continued to be targeted by
  phishing attacks. Those who received an email from an address ending in usa.org
  with a request for payment should delete the email and not click any ofthe links.

  Vice Chair Mazza asked if all of the rebuild applications received thus far were
  from homeowners at the time of the fire.

  In response to Vice Chair Mazza, Assistant Community Development Director
  Eaton stated applications had been received from both owners at the time of the
  fire as well as new owners. He noted that statistics were not maintained based on
  ownership characteristics as the rebuild plus ten percent option applied within the
  first six years regardless of when ownership began.

  Recorded Secretary Evans stated for the record that all Resolutions decided on
  November l7. 2025 would be updated to reflect the name of newly elected Chair
  Riddick.
